adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `updateEvents` was updated to handle multiple calendar references by changing `calendarReference` from a single `find(...)` to `filter(...)` and looping over them. However, in the merge path (`if (newBookingId) { ... }`), it still does `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"));` (singular) and thus would delete only one old calendar event reference even if the booking has multiple `_calendar` references (which is now plausible with `destinationCalendar` being an array and multiple events being created). This can leave orphaned external events for the other references.
